## About

I'm a cancer biologist and computational genomicist. My research uses single-cell
and bulk sequencing to work out how retinoblastoma tumors arise from developing
cone photoreceptors — which cell states are susceptible, and which genomic
alterations recur as tumors progress.

I build the analysis tooling that goes with that work: R and Bioconductor
packages, Shiny applications, and reproducible Snakemake pipelines for
single-cell data.
